scope.title: Scope

info.description: Lightweight teaching harness: Planner → Expert/Skills → validation, Formatter when needed.
info.title: Synaxis Teaching API

get.description: Artifact IDs are owner-authorized. Arbitrary paths are not accepted. Text/PNG returned as attachments.

post.description: Revokes access/refresh tokens on all account devices; returns 204.
No valid access token required. Refresh tokens are single-use and rotate atomically. Reuse revokes all account logins. Serialize refresh operations; never automatically retry completed rotations.
Administrators maintain the users table. No public registration. Use username/password in Swagger Authorize.

get.description: Returns image limits, experts, providers, tool status, image price and budget. configured does not mean live-verified. syllabus reports the local corpus edition, scope, modes and readiness; PythonBox uses local Linux nsjail.

post.description: Verifies the current password, updates Argon2id and revokes all access/refresh tokens. Log in again after success.

put.description: PUT replaces preferences; omitted fields reset to defaults. Applies to new-session defaults, with explicit request fields taking precedence. Does not grant paid-image consent.

get.description: Keyset pagination by pin, updated time and ID descending; cursors bind filters. Archives excluded by default; use archived=only/all. q searches titles, summaries and student public messages. Updates can move entries in the live directory.

post.description: Returns queued. Send a unique Idempotency-Key per submission. Matching retries return the original 202 receipt without rerunning; changed payload gives 409, deleted session gives 410. Omitted teaching parameters use account preferences.

delete.description: Cancels execution then soft-deletes; repeated deletion gives 204. Hides directory entries, details, messages, events and files. Ledger and underlying data remain for administration; no physical erasure. Old idempotent receipts give 410.

post.description: question_id must match the pending question. Supports Idempotency-Key; unkeyed duplicates return 409. Resumes Expert context under the same budget.

get.description: CNY 5 total per session including follow-ups, assistants and images. Conservative reservations precede dispatch; estimates use CNY peak rates. Unknown outcomes retain uncertain charges. Persisted independently of ledger retention; not a provider invoice.

Text uses output_start/delta/end; reasoning uses reasoning_start/delta/end. Append by stream_id/sequence. Render validated presentation in block order. artifact is a round log; thinking reports Max escalation only. Comment heartbeats every 15s. Resume via after/Last-Event-ID; a turn ends with normal EOF. Disconnect does not cancel teaching. On foreground, sync state and resubscribe only while running. See EventPage.

Paginate ascending message IDs; after=0 starts at the beginning. Includes student questions/answers/follow-ups and teaching presentations. Images are JWT-protected references. Reconstructed legacy timestamps are marked inferred.

post.description: Continue completed/failed/cancelled sessions using Expert context. waiting requires answers; running gives 409. Supports Idempotency-Key. Paid images default to no consent per follow-up. All turns share the session CNY 5 budget.

Offline search of the designated 2017 standards for nine subjects. Use English subject IDs; filter compulsory/selective-compulsory content. Modes: lexical/semantic/hybrid (default). source.pdf_pages is 1-based PDF order; printed_pages is printed numbering; sha256 identifies the source PDF. Scores are rankings, not confidence. Preserve shared scope and quality warnings. No separate exam/provincial syllabus; no hit does not imply exclusion. No cloud embedding or paid call.

get.description: Use a search hit's section_id to read its parent, page fragments and classification evidence. Missing: 404; unavailable: 503.

Own calls, provider token counts; cost is estimated or null. DeepSeek uses Beijing peak/off-peak rates at request start, snapshotted in pricing_basis; budget reserves peak rates. Keep USD/CNY separate; not a supplier invoice.
Inclusive UTC dates, at most 366 days; defaults to the last 30 days. Decimal costs stay separated by currency; unknown_cost_calls is explicit. Supports day/session/total with cursors.
get.summary: Summarize by session, date and currency
